rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone selfishly wanting more.

example.english: They are really greedy and want everything they see.
example.traditional: 佢真係貪心，見到咩都想要。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zan1 hai6 taam1 sam1 gin3 dou2 me1 dou1 soeng2 jiu3

rows.note: Use this specifically for someone who is overly fond of eating or tends to overeat.

example.english: You're so greedy when it comes to food—don't eat all the biscuits by yourself.
example.traditional: 你咁為食，啲餅唔好一個人食晒呀。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 wai6 sik6 di1 beng2 m4 hou2 jat1 go3 jan4 sik6 saai3 aa3
